author: miramurati
text: We started Thinking Machines to advance human-AI collaboration, and this is our first bet on what that looks like. Most labs treat autonomy as the goal and interactivity as scaffolding around a turn-based core. We think the way we work with AI matters as much as how smart it is.

author: miramurati
text: The current “AI experience” often feels like a conversation that only begins after we stop talking. We have to batch our thoughts. We can’t point at things. We phrase questions like emails. The interface doesn't leave room for us so we adapt to the models.

author: miramurati
text:
Today we're sharing our work on interaction models. A new class of model trained from scratch to handle real-time interaction natively, instead of gluing it onto a turn-based one.
https://t.co/MoS5s4cm60
